note.question: What determines a pricing problem for a single-server queue where customers arrive according to a Poisson process?
note.overview: This paper studies a pricing problem for a single-server queue where customers arrive according to a Poisson process. For each arriving customer, the service provider announces a price rate and system wait time. In response, the customer decides whether to join the queue, and, if so, the duration of the service time.
